ValidationRule.description: Only the Event's Assigned user, or having the Bypass_Restrict_Schedule_Seller_Events custom permission can edit Status and Description fields.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Permission.Bypass_Restrict_Schedule_Seller_Events ) , ( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Schedule_Seller' ) , NOT( ISNEW() ) , NOT( Owner:User.Id = $User.Id ) , OR( ISCHANGED( Description ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Event Owner is allowed to modify this field for Schedule Seller Events.
